name: MSP60K
description: MSP60K is a large-scale, cross-domain pedestrian attribute recognition dataset consisting of 60,122 images annotated with 57 attributes across eight scenarios. It aims to fill the data gap in pedestrian attribute recognition by including diverse domains and synthetic degradation to simulate real-world challenges.
reputation: A newer large-scale pedestrian attribute recognition dataset that is useful for cross-domain robustness studies, but not yet as widely established as older PAR benchmarks.
notes: Includes cross-domain splits and synthetic degradation; also proposes an LLM-augmented framework for attribute classification.
